Missing social/operator discussion coverage. | GitHub snapshot: multiple high-traction agent platforms and vendor releases (Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic, Dify, Bisheng) plus infra primitives (MCP telemetry, runtimes, security gateways). Missing social/operator discussion for field reports. | Package-registry snapshot: many new/updated MCP, sandbox, observability, and memory packages. Strong signals: VS Code observability extension (OkahuAI) and popular MutyAgent VS Code extension. Wide surface of MCP/sandbox primitives needing corroboration and social/operator reports.
